issues.reason: Time's own parenthetical contrasts an event-denoting noun ('the show', 'the storm') as one that 'stays an ordinary sk_ entity', and Existential reserves the bare class symbol for non-specific/generic objects 'never for a specific definite individual', so the definite event-noun 'the new-moon spring tide' owed a witness plus its class atom rather than the bare kind symbol.

The individual/class conflation the reviewer points at is real, but it lives in statement 12's bare-symbol filler, not here: (Inheritance new_moon_spring_tide tide) is the mandatory compound-kind genus of Compound concepts, definitionally true with a kind on both sides, and survives unchanged into the compliant parse.

gaps_confirmed: no licensed filler shape for a temporal adjunct headed by 'at' whose object is a definite common-noun event NP ('at the new-moon spring tide') - Time takes structured calendar/clock terms, deictic constants and day-parts, while event-noun anchors are covered only for Before/After ordering and for During/while/throughout

no licensed term for a non-Gregorian day-of-year date ('day 525 of Year 2') - the (Day <n>) constructor is specified as a day-of-month inside a Month/Year decomposition and nothing says whether a bare day-of-year count may fill it
new_gaps: a measure-partitive container phrase ('nine buckets of salt-bloom') has no licensed positive form: Possessive/genitive NP excludes 'a cup of water' from the genitive mapping but nothing states what carries it, so the parse's (Measure sk_salt_bloom_1 unspecified 9 bucket) - a container noun as unit, 'unspecified' as scale - is unguided improvisation

the 'the next / the following morning' rule says to copy 'the antecedent's' day terms plus one, but does not say which prior eventuality is the antecedent when the immediately preceding event carries no day terms and an earlier sentence in the same passage does ('day 525' here, making day 526 arguably recoverable) - the parse's day-part-only fallback and a day-526 term are both readable off the same rule
defect_summary: For confirmed issue 0 the compliant form mints the event-noun witness and fills the adjunct with it - (Member sk_tide_1 new_moon_spring_tide) at top level, the genus atom (Inheritance new_moon_spring_tide tide) unchanged, and the adjunct as (Time sk_lead_1 sk_tide_1) - but the Time role's filler grammar nowhere admits an entity witness and 'at' is not one of the three words that license During, so the attachment head itself has no licensed form; that is the first confirmed gap above.
notes: The rest of the passage is sound: the copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit on 'the moon was new', the 'a flock of birds' treatment of 'a harvest party of three people', the event-anaphoric reuse of sk_harvest_1 for 'the harvest', record/report as Theme-taking verbs, and the no-Name reading of 'the Council'. The (Day 525) and 'nine buckets' improvisations are acceptable under the calibration line - every slot is traceable to the words - and are filed as gaps, not counted against the parse.
